newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle Thursday, holiday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle Thursday, holiday roundup - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 7 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet Thursday and the holiday weekend, USDA said. Not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.
Confirmed - 300 last week - 200 last year - none.

Sales confirmed on 300 cattle Thursday, mostly heifers. Last week's confirmed sales 76,600 head including 20,800 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter heifers - On Thursday, pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 62.00; pen mixed slaughter steers and heifers Commercial to Choice with end heiferettes 1125 lbs 61.00.
